reserveReview.rationale: LeverUp documents lvUSD as the liquidity-layer token automatically minted when a trader opens a position with USDC collateral and redeemable through the protocol's USDC reserve flow. At Monad block 0x5d1f4b9 on 2026-08-20, the LVUSD issuer transparency contract returned one vault (0xc69d584b3118e94b3443cc6c67076281242fa704); its reserveToken() is USDC (0x754704bc059f8c67012fed69bc8a327a5aafb603) and its balance was 896,453.376929 USDC. MON collateral belongs to the separate LVMON issuer and no additional LVUSD vault was returned.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: LeverUp documentation plus the LVUSD issuer transparency vault and its current Monad USDC balance
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No additional direct lvUSD collateral asset is identified in the current issuance documentation; protocol trading gains or losses can change reserve coverage but do not introduce another authored reserve dependency.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: lvUSD's USDC collateral sits inside LeverUp's protocol trading system on Monad rather than with a named legal custodian; the reviewed documentation does not establish account segregation, insolvency treatment, or collateral reuse terms, and trading gains or losses can change reserve coverage.
